ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.description: Digest identifies immutable bytes using a named digest algorithm.

algorithm.description: algorithm identifies the canonical digest algorithm, for example sha256.

hex.description: hex is the lower-case encoded digest value.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.title: Digest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.MultimodalLaneCov.description: MultimodalLaneCoverage discloses one readiness lane without hiding failure.

coveragePerMille.description: coverage_per_mille is complete denominator coverage in [0, 1000].

required.description: required marks lanes that block complete readiness when absent or failed.

state.description: state is the bounded lane lifecycle.
state.title: Multimodal Lane State

ouroboros.contracts.v1.MultimodalLaneCov.title: Multimodal Lane Coverage

deletionState.description: deletion_state is the shared deletion vocabulary.

extractorIdentity.description: extractor_identity pins the certified extractor used for derived work.

kind.description: kind echoes the admitted modality family.

sourceId.description: source_id is the opaque server-authored source identity.
